name: composition-guide
description:
Applies photographic composition principles to a described subject including
rule of thirds grid placement, leading lines direction, foreground/background
layering, frame-within-frame opportunities, and negative space allocation.
Produces specific framing instructions applicable to any camera.
Use when the user asks about photo composition, framing a shot, or
arranging visual elements in a photograph.
Do NOT use for exposure or camera settings (use exposure-triangle),
lighting setup (use lighting-setup), or post-processing workflow
(use photo-editing-workflow).
